Harness adapters new release! 

Same model, same harness but almost 2x the perfs on coding tasks while being 50% more efficient.

We're releasing the first of our Qwen3.8-27B harness adapters: a small LoRA that makes Qwen3.8-27B a much stronger model behind the pi coding agent!

The results, evaluated under pi: 
- SWE-bench Pro (hard 51): 29% → 63% of tasks solved
- Terminal-Bench 2.1: 40% → 56% (16 tasks newly solved vs 2 lost) 
55–62% fewer tool calls per task, so faster and cheaper agent runs

On one real SWE-bench Pro task (the one you see in the figure), the base model searched and re-ran snippets until it hit the 100-step limit. The harness adapter version found completed the full task, in only 8 tool calls.

The final model is a ~300 MB adapter on a frozen base model, so it runs wherever Qwen3.8-27B already runs: vLLM, transformers serve, llama.cpp (GGUF included) or Llama.app on macOS. It can also be merged into the base in a few lines with PEFT.

Built with TRL's AsyncGRPOTrainer and OpenEnv, with every tool call screened by safeagents.

This is the first of several: adapters for more harnesses are coming in the next few days, and on Friday we'll share the full recipe in a comprehensive blog post, so anyone can train and release adapters for their own harness.
